derivation:
rw [← map_pow, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply 𝒪 (chartVRing 𝒪 r) (Avn 𝒪 r π n), Ideal.Quotient.algebraMap_eq, map_pow, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
exact Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton _)
explanation: Unfolding `Avn`, the target is the image of the generator `(algebraMap 𝒪 (chartVRing 𝒪 r) π) ^ (n + 1)` in the quotient by the ideal it generates. `Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem` reduces vanishing to membership in that ideal, which follows from `Ideal.subset_span`.
